_comment: Force Content-Type: image/png on extensionless opengraph-image files. Next.js with output:'export' generates the per-article OG images at /blog/<slug>/opengraph-image (no extension), and Vercel's static MIME guesser falls back to application/octet-stream — which Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Discord all reject as invalid. Without this header, every per-article OG card silently breaks on share. The headers config applies on top of the static export.
